notes: The suggestion that |x|^2.001+|y|^2.001=1 yields only ellipses is false: the five oval points with y=k/1000 (k=1..5) near the vertex (1,0) determine a nondegenerate hyperbola (b^2-4ac ~ 5.17e-56), certified by 120-digit interval arithmetic. Known: Georgiou, arXiv 2608.00790 (2026). The open-ended part (describe all such sets) is not addressed. Outside Lean: the whole interval computation (transcendental coordinates).
